versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema sjeveru, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje na krajevima cijele zemlje vidjeh velik i slavan poredak.

verses.text_en: And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh troja nebeska vrata otvorena na nebu. Kroz svaka od njih izlaze sjeverni vjetrovi; kad pušu, donose hladnoću, tuču, mraz, snijeg, rosu i kišu.

verses.text_en: And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, †it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.†
verses.text_hr: Kroz jedna vrata pušu na dobro, ali kad pušu kroz druga dvoja, †čine to silovito i donose nevolju zemlji; silovito pušu.†
